description_en: Updates the idle mode of an application
kebab_example: aliyun sae update-app-mode --enable-idle true --app-id 7171a6ca-d1cd-4928-8642-7d5cfe690000 --namespace-id cn-shanghai --app-ids 7171a6ca-d1cd-4928-8642-7d5cfe690000,7802c49a-67bc-4167-8369-9a9c003c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
